allowed.why: DxB_Build — the construction site's own Supabase stack (B36 Block 2). Separate cluster, separate port 54422, separate volume; the company does not exist on this engine. Re-take this with --allow after any 'supabase stop --no-backup' — destroying the volume gives the cluster a NEW identity and the guard rightly refuses the old one.

what: Which database engine the CONSTRUCTION may write to, and which one it may never touch. Anything on `allowed` is a construction engine; `company` is the holding and is refused outright. Identity comes from the server — the cluster's system_identifier plus the database's own oid and name — never from the address, because six spellings of one address were measured reaching the same engine while a text comparison called each of them different. Read by tests/global-teardown.ts (the battery refuses to start against the company), tests/construction-engine.ts and db/seed/build-seed.ts. It was born for a SessionEnd token hook that the CEO abolished on 2026-08-25 ("artık yazılmasın"); the guard outlived it because the battery needs the same refusal.
